en_title: Netflix Lays Off Over 1,000 People, Around 6% of the Workforce
subtitle: 史上最大规模裁员
opus_summary: Netflix裁员逾千人，约占员工总数的6%，规模创公司纪录，主要涉及产品、技术、法务及人力资源团队。两位联席负责人表示，业务仍在增长，全年业绩预期不变。

paragraphs.en: Netflix has laid off over 1,000 staff in its biggest cutbacks to date, amounting to around 6% of its workforce. The cuts will predominantly affect its product, technology, legal and HR teams.
paragraphs.cn: Netflix已裁员逾1,000人，约占员工总数的6%，是公司迄今规模最大的一轮裁员。本轮裁员主要涉及产品、技术、法务和人力资源团队。

paragraphs.en: “Our mission — to entertain the world — is ambitious, and delivering on it requires us to be disciplined about where we prioritize our people and resources,” co-CEOs Ted Sarandos and Greg Peters wrote in an email to employees, via WSJ .
paragraphs.cn: 据《华尔街日报》报道，联席首席执行官Ted Sarandos和Greg Peters在致员工的邮件中写道：「我们的使命是为全世界带来娱乐，这是一个雄心勃勃的目标。要实现这个目标，我们就必须审慎决定优先将人力和资源投入哪些领域。」

paragraphs.en: “Our business is strong and growing, and we remain on track to deliver our full-year forecast. We’ll continue to invest aggressively in high-impact areas to improve our service and further drive growth and innovation. Doing that means making focused choices across the business so we can keep delivering for our members, partners, employees, and investors.”
paragraphs.cn: 「我们的业务稳健且持续增长，仍有望按计划实现全年业绩预期。我们将继续大力投资影响重大的领域，改善服务，进一步推动增长与创新。为此，我们需要在各项业务中明确取舍，才能持续为会员、合作伙伴、员工和投资者创造价值。」

paragraphs.en: Despite having a range of beloved exclusives, Netflix has struggled to keep up with audience demand lately, with some accusing it of adopting a quantity over quality approach. In a recently announced deal with Disney, Netflix plans to license shows from the rival streaming service to help meet demand.
paragraphs.cn: 尽管拥有多部深受喜爱的独家作品，Netflix最近仍难以满足观众需求，有人指责它重数量、轻质量。根据近期公布的迪士尼合作协议，Netflix计划获得这家竞争对手旗下流媒体服务的节目授权，以帮助满足需求。

paragraphs.en: In the deal, Netflix will host select Disney+ content for its 325 million subscribers, including a mix of legacy titles and currently streaming TV shows. Netflix recently announced its streaming lineup for October , which includes miniseries East of Eden, Ben Affleck’s Animals, and Josh Hartnett squaring off against a sea beast in Below. On October 20, Netflix will release the second season of its Studio Trigger-produced anime series, Cyberpunk: Edgerunners Season 2 .
paragraphs.cn: 根据协议，Netflix将向其3.25亿订阅用户提供部分Disney+内容，既包括旧作，也包括正在播出的剧集。Netflix近日公布了10月上线片单，其中包括迷你剧《伊甸之东》、本·阿弗莱克的《Animals》，以及乔什·哈奈特与海兽对决的《Below》。10月20日，Netflix将上线由TRIGGER制作的动画剧集《赛博朋克：边缘行者》第2季。

paragraphs.en: Netflix has also attempted to break into gaming to increase dwell time on its service. Most famously, the GTA 6 Extended Look was a Netflix exclusive for the first few hours. By all accounts, it was a hit, breaking 31.1 million views in its first week.
paragraphs.cn: Netflix也曾尝试进军游戏领域，以延长用户在平台上的停留时间。其中最广为人知的是，《GTA6》加长展示视频最初几个小时仅在Netflix独家播出。从各方反响来看，这段视频大获成功，首周播放量突破3,110万次。

paragraphs.en: In June, the company released FIFA World Cup: Launch Edition as the latest game to include in its tucked away gaming section. But in August, the developer behind Netflix’s soccer game laid off 85% of its staff . Reviewers criticized the game's controls, graphics, AI, and pretty much everything else. In March this year, Netflix increased its prices again . According to Variety , a Netflix spokesperson said the company did not have any comment beyond the memo about layoffs.
paragraphs.cn: 6月，Netflix推出《FIFA World Cup: Launch Edition》，为其不显眼的游戏专区增添了一款新作。但到了8月，这款Netflix足球游戏的开发商裁掉了85%的员工。评测者批评了游戏的操作、画面、AI，以及几乎所有其他方面。今年3月，Netflix再次涨价。据《综艺》报道，Netflix发言人表示，除裁员备忘录外，公司没有其他评论。
